This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
Leonard Hayes is HarmonyGames' co-founder/CEO and the current date is Feb 14, 2026. He wants the stockholder/optionholder close-out done the way his Linear "Holder records" project and his Drive doc "Stockholder close-out notes" lay it out. That means:
- **Holder sheet** in his close-out folder.
- **Investor letter** in the same folder, worked up from his investor email draft in #winddown, using the sections of the update outline.
- **Holder messages** as Gmail drafts. These wait for him: he reads and sends each himself.
- **Linear issues** updated.
- **Heads-up to Griffin**, sent as a reply on the Feb 12 "Board position" thread.
- **Reply in #winddown** under his "next things for me are" list, saying who goes first.
- **Answer to KPMG's audit request for Griffin** (Feb 13).

His exact words on sending: "Send the replies yourself, no need to check with me; only the holder messages wait for me."

2. Key Technical Concepts / Rules

From the close-out notes doc (f_a37b403d5200d4f0a31d31):
- Carta is the record. If a line's last day has passed, it holds nothing.
- One row per issue on the sheet and at most one note per person. The three founders appear only in the totals.
- "Told" means a written message about the closing, sent directly by Leonard, Robert or Arthur. For a fund, the message goes to its partner.
- Everyone still holding something gets what they are owed:
  - the closing, if they have not been told;
  - their last day, if they have one.
- Whoever's last day comes first goes first.
- Each note says what the holder holds.
- Any question about their holding that was never answered gets answered in their note.
- Notice route is the email we have, unless a document says otherwise.
- Sheet labels: Nothing, Already told, Closing, Last day, Closing and last day.
- Everything goes in the close-out folder (d_601064334a0b493022fe83), not the Wind Down folder.
- The holder sheet comes first; the notes and everything else run off it.
- Share the sheet and the letter with Robert. Notes should be ready by Tuesday as Gmail drafts.
- Griffin heads-up: reply on the Feb 12 Board position thread with what we still need from Griffin, once the sheet is right.
- #winddown: when the sheet is ready, reply under his list and say who goes first.

From Leonard's #winddown thread replies (under ts 1770934638.035469):
- One note to whoever has always handled it for a family covers the rest of that family's lines, which need no note of their own. Mark those lines "Covered" on the sheet in place of a label, and count them that way.
- "And the sheet goes to Arthur as well as Robert, the rest of my notes stands."

From the Linear project description:
- After the sheet is done, set states as follows:
  - Canceled where the line holds nothing.
  - Otherwise Todo where the line's own note is waiting for Leonard.
  - Done where there is no note waiting.
- On every issue with no note of its own, Canceled included, add a comment saying why.
- Leonard passes the sheet to Sunset himself.
- KPMG's confirmation goes back as a reply-all once the sheet is right.

Sunset's intake request (thread 1857034369525983506) asks for one sheet containing:
- one line per holder, with what each holds today (vested options only) and any last day;
- total shares and options outstanding;
- a count of holders by what each still needs to hear;
- directors in office and who holds the preferred vote;
- how each holder gets formal notice, including any special terms.

Sunset also said formal notices are a separate step, so the notes don't need to double as notices.

KPMG request (thread 1857029474983245439; from PERSON_3088_EMAIL; cc PERSON_4416_EMAIL, PERSON_2322_EMAIL, PERSON_2847_EMAIL; reply to all; due 2/27/2026). Confirm as of Dec 31, 2025:
1. Shares outstanding by class, showing what each fund holds.
2. Each outstanding option line by holder, plus the total, using each effective date as Carta shows it regardless of when recorded.
3. Shares plus those options as one figure.
4. Any financing or other significant event since that date.

KPMG's follow-up clarified that a termination effective on the as-of date itself counts as of that date. Leonard already replied "I'll get this to you before the 27th."

3. Files / Sources and Key Data

Linear (team ENG, project "Holder records", ec2ea957-fc8e-4958-b809-0fb735b1e916):

- State IDs: Todo state_f5f67279df1a52c2, Done state_f71945f4d2e95895, Canceled state_7e56143481a65571.

Drive files:

  - "Stockholder close-out notes" (doc)
  - "Holder list (draft)" sheet f_5ecaa967db3adcfa440b09: stale; columns Holder/Shares/Notes, 7 rows copied from the Nov 2024 list.
  - "Harmony Games February 26 Update" slides f_75dddccabb26eeea4842c8, which is the outline: What happened (why we are closing and when the team stopped); Where things stand (27 holders on the Nov 2024 owner list; board, process, who is running the close); What it means for you (distributions, tax papers, your options); What happens to the games and the IP; Thank you.
- TOR side letter: f_6201c7027d02997bfb2c84 (draft dated 28 August).
- Seed SPA: f_95d91c8c1c1dcf7ea62075; its purchaser schedule is blank.

Investor email draft in #winddown (C0ADGSZKR3R, ts 1770664700.848759). Its sections are:
- Hi everyone: we have decided to wind down.
- What we did and what we learned: three games — Domino Delights, Zombie Match 3D, Combo Fighter.
- Financial context: hardship since mid-2025; runway under a month.
- What happens next: orderly wind-down; board resolutions; employee and contractor obligations; tax/compliance; vendors; sunsetting products; IP disposition.

Facts to update the letter with:

Thank you for backing us and for your advice along the way. I'm happy to talk if you'd like; just reply here.

Best,

input.body:
Hi both,

A quick heads-up on the stockholder side of the wind-down. We've finished our holder records, and short notes to the rest of our stockholders and optionholders go out next week, starting with former team members whose exercise windows close soonest. An investor letter to all holders will follow. Sunset is running the dissolution, and their legal team will send the formal notices and approval requests separately.

Our records show Griffin holding 2,662,255 Series Seed Preferred in Griffin Gaming Partners II, L.P. and 84,438 in the Side Fund. That is 2,746,693 of 3,155,643 Series Seed shares (about 87%), so Griffin carries the preferred vote.

Here is what we still need from Griffin:
1. Written consent, as majority holder of the Series Seed Preferred, to the dissolution and Plan of Dissolution once Sunset's legal team sends it over.
2. Confirmation of the notice address and contact both funds want formal notices sent to.
3. Whether Griffin intends to designate a replacement Series Seed director or is happy to leave the seat vacant through the wind-down. The board is now Robert and me.

Thanks again for all the support.

Best,
Leonard

input.body:
Hello,

Below is Harmony Games, Inc.'s confirmation as of December 31, 2025, taken from our Carta records. For option terminations I've used the effective date Carta shows, whenever the termination was recorded. Per your clarification, a termination effective on December 31, 2025 is treated as effective as of that date.

1. Shares outstanding by class
- Common Stock: 6,000,000
- Series Seed Preferred Stock: 3,155,643, of which:
  - Griffin Gaming Partners II, L.P.: 2,662,255
  - Griffin Gaming Partners II Side Fund, L.P.: 84,438
- Total shares outstanding: 9,155,643

2. Outstanding options by holder
- ES-1 [PERSON_NAME_0043]: 17,802 (terminated effective Dec 31, 2025; vested portion only)
- ES-3 Calvin Price: 4,408
- ES-4 Claire Morgan: 4,450 (terminated effective Dec 31, 2025; vested portion only)
- ES-5 [PERSON_NAME_0612]: 5,298
- ES-7 Marcus Bennett: 22,889
- ES-12 [PERSON_NAME_0068]: 16,277
- ES-13 Martin Walsh: 3,866
- ES-14 [PERSON_NAME_0051]: 1,530
- ES-15 [PERSON_NAME_2769] [PERSON_NAME_0093]: 3,391 (terminated effective Dec 31, 2025; vested portion only)
- ES-16 [PERSON_NAME_2768] [PERSON_NAME_0011]: 10,384
- ES-17 [PERSON_NAME_0038]: 34,439
- ES-18 [PERSON_NAME_0022] [PERSON_NAME_2763]: 15,259
- Total options outstanding: 139,993

ES-7, ES-12, ES-13 and ES-18 were active at year end. They were terminated effective January 30, 2026, so the full grants are included. ES-3, ES-5, ES-14, ES-16 and ES-17 had terminated earlier but their vested shares were still within the exercise window on December 31, 2025. ES-2 and ES-6 had already expired and are not included.

3. Shares outstanding plus options outstanding: 9,295,636

4. Significant events since December 31, 2025
- No financing or issuance of equity.
- February 9, 2026: the board decided to wind down the company. We have engaged Sunset to run an orderly dissolution, including the Delaware dissolution, California and North Carolina withdrawals, and tax close-out.
- February 12, 2026: Griffin's designated director resigned from the board. The terminations of the four option lines above (effective January 30, 2026) were recorded in Carta. We also signed a data licensing agreement for anonymised game data, under which the company keeps ownership of its IP.
- We do not expect any distribution to stockholders in the dissolution.

Let me know if you need anything else or a signed version.

Best regards,
Leonard Hayes
CEO and Co-founder, Harmony Games, Inc.
